notAPoll: Topical public-opinion survey (Обществени нагласи – юни 2013, fieldwork 13–18 June 2013, 1019 respondents): it reports approval/trust ratings for parliament, government, president, judiciary and party leaders, support for the Oresharski plan measures and attitudes to the Peevski protests, but publishes no vote-intention figures for any party or candidate, in the press release, the PDF text, or its charts.
